Property Taxes in Andalucia: A Quick Guide

Property taxes in Andalucía, Spain, can be broken down into two main categories: taxes on buying property and annual taxes for owning property. Here’s a simplified rundown:

Buying Property:

  • Transfer Tax (ITP): The main tax levied on resale properties, currently at a reduced rate of 7% in Andalucía (compared to the national range of 8%-10%). This is good news for buyers!
  • Stamp Duty (AJD): Applies to notary documents like the sale deed. The rate in Andalucía is also reduced, currently at 1.2% (previously 1.5%).

Owning Property:

  • Wealth Tax: This tax has been suspended in Andalucía since 2022, meaning you won’t pay it for now.

It’s important to note that these are general points. Taxes can vary depending on factors like property value and your residency status.

For a more specific picture, consulting a tax professional or referring to official Andalusian government resources is recommended.
